item.title: Oil prices steady as Hormuz tanker attacks offset surplus outlook
item.description: Brent crude steadied as attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz offset rising US crude inventories and expectations of higher interest rates.

item.title: Nvidia beats earnings in first report since Jensen Huang resigned
item.description: Nvidia reported revenue of $115.84 billion. The board said it will not reinstate Huang as CEO.

item.title: Anthropic opens 34% above IPO price in record Nasdaq debut
item.description: Anthropic sold 980 million shares at $83 in the largest IPO on record; shares closed at $97.17.

item.title: Stocks fall as AI selloff deepens; Nasdaq slides
item.description: The S&P 500 fell 1% as AI stocks including Nvidia kept falling on worries their boom may be over.

item.title: Producer prices jump 6.5% annually, highest since 2022
item.description: Wholesale inflation accelerated in October, pushing Treasury yields higher and raising odds of a Fed rate hike.

item.title: Fed officials weigh another rate hike in December as inflation runs hot
item.description: Federal Reserve policymakers including Lisa Cook favor another rate hike, with the 10-year yield near 5%.
